title: Licensing
levelTitle: Level 28 - Cisco IOS and IOS XE

cards.a: Licensing controls which features are entitled on a device. Legacy EULA models (classic LICENSE) are being replaced by Smart Licensing; images carry a universalK9 package and licenses gate which features are enabled.

cards.q: What are the classic license package tiers?
cards.a: ipbase provides base routing, ipservices provides advanced features, and network-advantage provides the full feature set in modern IOS XE. Advantage tiers bundle more features.

cards.q: How do licenses gate a feature on IOS XE?
cards.a: A license is an entitlement flag evaluated per product PID. Without a valid license the feature will not enable and configuration may be denied; eval licenses let you try features and permanent licenses are owned.

cards.q: What license types exist on IOS XE?
cards.a: Eval (temporary, 60 days by default), an evaluation period (grace), Permanent (owned), Subscription (time-based), and RTU (right-to-use).

cards.q: What does the universalK9 image mean?
cards.a: It is a single image containing all features, gated by license. Feature-specific images have a smaller footprint, while the universal image is future-proof.

cards.q: Which commands check and show the license state?
cards.a: show license shows installed licenses, show license summary shows status, and show license feature shows what is available. license install activates a license and license boot level sets the tier.

cards.q: Compare classic licensing with Smart Licensing.
cards.a: Classic uses a PAK or a license file activated locally, with manual reporting and local enforcement. Smart Licensing uses the CSSM portal with automatic reporting and a subscription model.

cards.q: How do you install a license file and set the licensed tier?
cards.a: license install bootflash:license.lic activates the file, and license boot level network-advantage sets the tier; a reload is then required.

cards.q: A licensed feature is denied during configuration. What do you check?
cards.a: Check show license feature and show license summary for a missing or expired entitlement, confirm the correct license for the device PID, and install it with license install.
